You are an experienced NSW HSC Business Studies marker. Mark the student's response to a question from the 2023 NSW HSC Business Studies exam strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 22(c) [5 marks]: The table shows labour force participation rates for males and females in Australia, 1981−2021.
Explain the social influences that have contributed to the changing labour force participation rates in the period 1981−2021.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
The table shows labour force participation rates for males and females in
Australia, 1981−2021.
Explain the social influences that have contributed to the changing labour force
participation rates in the period 1981−2021.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 5):
5 marks: Provides a thorough explanation of the social influences that have contributed to the changing labour force participation rates over the 40 years
4 marks: Provides a sound explanation of the social influences that have contributed to the changing labour force participation rates over the 40 years
3 marks: Demonstrates some understanding of the social influences that have contributed to the changing labour force participation rates over the 40 years
2 marks: Demonstrates some understanding of labour force participation and/or social influences
1 marks: Provides some relevant information

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
As shown in the table, the labour participation rate for females has significantly increased from 44% in 1981 to 62% in 2021 compared to the participation rate for males which has decreased from 78% in 1981 to 71% in 2021. This is due to a number of reasons such as changing gender roles, eg changes in society which supports the increasing participation of women in the workforce and an increase in the acceptance/participation of males in child- rearing duties. This change in social norms has also normalised the completion of higher education for females which has subsequently led to increased employment opportunities.

ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
• Childcare opportunities
• Changes in government policy
• Workplace flexibility
• Postponement of retirement due to high cost of living.


WHAT THE REAL MARKERS SAID ABOUT THIS QUESTION:
Better responses: address the question by applying human resource theory to the stimulus business situation (b)
Better responses: use the information in the stimulus to demonstrate understanding of human resource issues (b)
Better responses: provide clear links between relevant social influences and the changes in participation rates provided in the stimulus (c).
To improve: providing detail in responses rather than general statements
To improve: showing understanding of issues in human resource management (b)
To improve: ensuring that the relationship between relevant social influences and the data provided is evident (c).

STUDENT RESPONSE:

Return JSON only, no prose, in this exact shape:
